scenario: 开通语言 — 用 IETF code(ja-JP)不是'日语';不支持的码会被静默丢弃,先查 supported

semantic_rubric: 日语 is sent as its IETF language code ja-JP inside codes[], not the word 日语 / Japanese
codes is an array — add takes one or more codes
aware that unsupported codes are SILENTLY dropped by the API: validates the code against shop languages supported first rather than trusting a guess
does not fabricate a code it has not confirmed is supported

notes: schema shop.languages.add: codes[] required (IETF, e.g. zh-CN, ja-JP); unsupported codes silently dropped. shop languages supported lists valid codes — validate first. Silent-drop trap, mirrors shoplazza-common's silently-dropped-filters theme.
